note: length of the simulated sensor series: one year ending on the last day of the climate record

name: sensor_seed
note: seed of the simulated sensor noise: the same seed gives the same series

name: sensor_noise_sd
note: standard deviation of the simulated sensor noise, m3/m3 (a typical capacitive probe)

name: sensor_bias
note: constant offset of the simulated sensor, m3/m3 (an uncalibrated probe)

name: sensor_truth_capacity_factor
note: the simulated field holds this share of the capacity the model was calibrated with: a soil the model does not know

name: sensor_truth_theta_min_shift
note: the simulated field's wilting point differs from the model's by this, m3/m3

name: sensor_truth_start_theta
note: moisture of the simulated field on 1 January, m3/m3; the model starts from simulated_theta

name: sensor_gain
note: share of the gap between modelled water and a reading that is corrected each day (0 ignores the sensor, 1 adopts it)

name: sensor_cadences
note: days between the readings the model receives in the sensor experiment

name: sensor_start_window_days
note: days from the start of the series over which the error is also reported: a sensor corrects a wrong starting state first

name: sensor_train_share
note: share of the sensor series used to fit the soil; the rest is kept to test it

name: fit_grid_points
note: points per parameter of the grid search that fits the soil to a sensor series

name: fit_rounds
note: rounds of the grid search; each one narrows the search around the best point

name: learn_seed
note: seed of every simulated draw of the learning layer: the same seed gives the same panel

name: learn_smap_noise_sd
note: standard deviation of the simulated satellite noise, m3/m3

name: learn_reference_noise_sd
note: error of the reference measurement (a weighed and dried soil sample) that calibrates a node, m3/m3

name: learn_panel_seasons
note: seasons of history per producer in the simulated panel (the app asks for the last five)

name: learn_spinup_days
note: days simulated before sowing so a season starts from the water its own climate left

name: learn_start_theta
note: moisture at the start of the spin-up of every simulated season, m3/m3

name: learn_yield_noise_sd
note: standard deviation of everything the water does not explain in a simulated yield (relative yield)

name: learn_rating_cuts
note: relative yield below which a producer rates a season very bad, bad, good and very good; above the last, excellent

note: standard deviation of the simulated NDVI noise

name: learn_pool_k_a
note: seasons of own data a crop needs to weigh as much as the region in model A

note: share of the fields kept apart to validate a model

name: learn_holdout_rounds
note: random splits of fields averaged in every validation

name: learn_min_days_b
note: days of overlap with a calibrated node a field needs for its own correction (spec)

name: learn_min_examples_a
note: seasons per crop needed to publish model A (spec)

name: learn_min_examples_c
note: seasons needed to publish model C (spec)

name: learn_forest_trees
note: trees of the random forest of model C

name: learn_ndvi_good_cut
note: rise over bare soil that marks the start of green in a curve summary

note: soil score below which the state is poor (provisional)

name: soil_trend_delta

name: soil_cover_bonus
note: score gained in a season with a cover crop or a pasture

note: months of bare soil per year that cost nothing

name: soil_bare_month_penalty
note: score lost for every bare month per year above the ones that cost nothing

name: soil_erosion_tolerance
note: estimated erosion in t/ha/year above which the soil loses score (provisional)

name: soil_organic_low
note: organic matter in percent below which the soil loses score

name: soil_organic_high
note: organic matter in percent from which the soil gains score

name: soil_analysis_adjust
note: score moved by a low or a high organic matter

name: soil_unmodelled_cycle_days
note: days a crop with no calendar in the table (sunflower, double crop) occupies the soil

name: soil_min_seasons_trend
note: seasons of history needed to say whether the soil improves or worsens

name: soil_index_low
note: productivity index (CONEAT: 100 is the national average) at or below which a soil unit holds the least water of the panel (provisional)

name: soil_index_mid

name: soil_index_high
note: productivity index at or above which a soil unit holds the most water of the panel

name: soil_capacity_low
note: capacity factor of the simulated soil at the lowest index

name: soil_capacity_high
note: capacity factor of the simulated soil at the highest index

name: learn_smap_scale_by_texture

name: learn_smap_offset_jitter

name: learn_smap_scale_jitter
note: how far a field strays from its texture class in the planted satellite scale
